knowledge:
- key_parameters: eset=The ExpressionSet or SummarizedExperiment object containing the expression data and metadata ;; colorVar=Name of the phenoData/colData column used to color sample points ;; shapeVar=Name of the phenoData/colData column used for sample point shapes ;; sizeVar=Name of the phenoData/colData column used for sample point sizes ;; alphaVar=Name of the phenoData/colData column used for sample point transparency ;; topSamples=Number of outlying samples to label based on distance from the origin ;; topGenes=Number of outlying genes to label based on distance from the origin ;; typePlot=Type of plot to generate, either "static" (default) or "interactive" ;; packageInteractivity=Interactive plotting package to use, either "plotly" or "ggvis" ;; dim=A vector of two integers specifying which PCA dimensions to plot (spectral map only, default is c(1,2)) ;; ldaVar=The grouping factor variable in phenoData used for Linear Discriminant Analysis ;; returnAnalysis=Logical indicating whether to return the raw analysis data and top elements alongside the plot
- alternatives: ggplot2 is used for static plots and can be used to further customize the returned ggplot objects. plotly or ggvis are used for interactive plots. mpm is used for spectral map calculations, Rtsne for t-SNE, and MASS (lda) for LDA.
- when_to_use: Use when you want to explore and visualize sample groupings, batch effects, or outlying genes/samples in transcriptomics datasets using spectral maps, t-SNE, or LDA, while mapping multiple clinical/phenotypic covariates to visual aesthetics.
- pitfalls: t-SNE and LDA can be computationally expensive on large datasets; it is recommended to pre-filter features or use the fctTransformDataForInputTsne parameter to pre-calculate distance matrices. The logtrans parameter in mpm defaults to FALSE, assuming data is already log-transformed; if not, set logtrans=TRUE via mpm.args. Gene Ontology hierarchical structures can cause highly overlapping gene set labels when plotting top gene sets.

workflows.name: spectral_map_visualization
workflows.intent: Generate a spectral map biplot (static or interactive) from an expression dataset, mapping sample metadata to aesthetics and labeling outlying genes, samples, or gene sets.
input: expression_data.RData (An ExpressionSet or SummarizedExperiment object containing expression values and sample/feature annotations)
workflows.stages: 1. Load the dataset and format metadata. 2. (Optional) Retrieve gene sets using getGeneSetsForPlot. 3. Generate the spectral map using esetSpectralMap.
workflows.code:
print(esetSpectralMap(eset = ALL))

print(esetSpectralMap(eset = ALL, title = "Acute lymphoblastic leukemia dataset \n Spectral map \n Sample annotation (1)", colorVar = "BT", color = colorPalette, shapeVar = "sex", sizeVar = "age", sizeRange = c(0.1, 6), alphaVar = "remissionType", alpha = c(0.3, 0.6, 0.9), topSamples = 0, topGenes = 0, cloudGenes = TRUE))

geneSets <- getGeneSetsForPlot(
	entrezIdentifiers = fData(ALL)$ENTREZID, 
	species = "Human", 
	geneSetSource = 'GOBP',
	useDescription = TRUE)

print(esetSpectralMap(eset = ALL, title = "Acute lymphoblastic leukemia dataset \n Spectral map \n Gene set annotation", colorVar = "BT", color = colorPalette, shapeVar = "sex", sizeVar = "age", sizeRange = c(2, 6), alphaVar = "remissionType", alpha = c(0.3, 0.6, 0.9), topGenes = 0, topGeneSets = 4, geneSets = geneSets, geneSetsVar = "ENTREZID", geneSetsMaxNChar = 30, topGeneSetsCex = 2, topGeneSetsColor = "purple"))

esetSpectralMap(
	eset = ALL,
	title = paste("Acute lymphoblastic leukemia dataset - spectral map"),
	colorVar = "BT", color = unname(colorPalette),
	shapeVar = "sex",
	alphaVar = "remissionType",
	typePlot = "interactive", packageInteractivity = "plotly",
	figInteractiveSize = c(700, 600),
	topGenes = 10, topGenesVar = "SYMBOL",
	topSamples = 10,
	interactiveTooltipExtraVars = varLabels(ALL)
)

workflows.name: tsne_visualization
workflows.intent: Perform t-SNE dimensionality reduction on expression data and visualize sample distributions with metadata aesthetics.
input: expression_data.RData (An ExpressionSet or SummarizedExperiment object containing expression values and sample annotations)
workflows.stages: 1. Run t-SNE and plot using esetTsne. 2. (Optional) Run t-SNE with a custom data pre-transformation function to speed up computation.
workflows.code:
print(esetTsne(eset = ALL, 
	title = "Acute lymphoblastic leukemia dataset \n Tsne",
	colorVar = "BT", color = colorPalette,
	shapeVar = "sex",
	sizeVar = "age", sizeRange = c(2, 6),
	alphaVar = "remissionType", alpha = c(0.3, 0.6, 0.9),
	topSamplesVar = "cod"
))

print(esetTsne(eset = ALL, 
	title = "Acute lymphoblastic leukemia dataset \n Tsne",
	colorVar = "BT", color = colorPalette,
	shapeVar = "sex",
	sizeVar = "age", sizeRange = c(2, 6),
	alphaVar = "remissionType", alpha = c(0.3, 0.6, 0.9),
	topSamplesVar = "cod",
	fctTransformDataForInputTsne = 
		function(mat)	as.dist((1 - cor(mat))/2)
))

workflows.name: lda_visualization
workflows.intent: Perform semi-supervised Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA) to maximize variance between levels of a grouping factor and visualize the results.
input: expression_data.RData (An ExpressionSet or SummarizedExperiment object containing expression values and sample annotations)
workflows.stages: 1. Subset features to reduce computation time. 2. Run LDA and generate plot using esetLda. 3. (Optional) Modify plot parameters post-hoc using esetPlotWrapper.
workflows.code:
retainedFeatures <- sample(featureNames(ALL), size = floor(nrow(ALL)/5))

outputEsetLda <- esetLda(eset = ALL[retainedFeatures, ], ldaVar = "BT",
	title = paste("Acute lymphoblastic leukemia dataset \n",
		"Linear discriminant analysis on BT variable \n",
		"(Subset of the feature data)"),
	colorVar = "BT", color = colorPalette,
	shapeVar = "sex",
	sizeVar = "age", sizeRange = c(2, 6),
	alphaVar = "remissionType", alpha = c(0.3, 0.6, 0.9),
	topSamplesVar = "cod", topGenesVar = "SYMBOL",
	returnAnalysis = TRUE
)

print(outputEsetLda$plot)

esetPlotWrapper(
	dataPlotSamples = outputEsetLda$analysis$dataPlotSamples,
	dataPlotGenes = outputEsetLda$analysis$dataPlotGenes,
	esetUsed = outputEsetLda$analysis$esetUsed,
	title = paste("Acute lymphoblastic leukemia dataset \n",
		"Linear discriminant analysis on BT variable (2) \n",
		"(Subset of the feature data)"),
	colorVar = "BT", color = colorPalette,
	shapeVar = "remissionType", 
	sizeVar = "age", sizeRange = c(2, 6),
	alphaVar = "remissionType", alpha = c(0.3, 0.6, 0.9),
	topSamplesVar = "cod", topGenesVar = "SYMBOL"
)
